summary: PGS005206 (BMD_PRS, 81 variants, GRCh38 harmonized scoring file matching its approved SHA-256 pin) was applied to a synthetic effect-allele dosage file for 20 individuals using the Stage 2 scorer. All 20 individuals were scored with QC status PASS (0 PARTIAL, 0 LOW_COVERAGE, 0 NO_DATA), with variant coverage of 1.0 and no effect-allele mismatches in the 81 checked variants. The score's reported phenotype is bone mineral density; its PGS Catalog trait fields name no skeletal site, and a total-body site is supported only by the linked source GWAS GCST005348 (total body bone mineral density). The input data are synthetic. The target data contain no phenotypes or ancestry, so predictive validity and transferability could not be measured. The only recorded evaluation is in European children (n=3470, Generation R). In the scoring file, 24 variants have an ambiguous other allele and 5 are palindromic. The original genome build is not reported, the derivation of the 81 weights is unverified, and allele agreement does not test strand harmonization of real genotypes. Per-individual scores are in artifacts/prs_scores_1.csv. No percentiles, risk categories or clinical interpretation are provided.
